submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F3 with 6 mm plates. Among the eligible candidate absorber materials and allowed 2–10 mm plate thicknesses, the recorded final best configuration is material index/code 3 at 6 mm, with the lowest observed 100 GeV energy resolution of 3.016%. This outperforms the best recorded configurations for F1 and F2 in the scan and satisfies the maintenance eligibility constraint.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: The final recorded optimum is Absorber-F3 at 6 mm with 3.016% energy resolution, the lowest value in the recorded scan.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: material_count = 3 and final_best_material_index = 3, corresponding to Absorber-F3, one of the listed candidates.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: eligible_material_count = 3 with eligible material indices 1, 2, and 3; excluded_material_count = 0, so Absorber-F3 is eligible for hands-on maintenance.
Recommended plate thickness is 6 mm, within the recorded allowed range of 2–10 mm.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one configuration: Absorber-F3 with 6 mm plates.
